title: Pin planfile sync reusable workflow to immutable SHA

delivery.problem: The Planfile GitHub sync workflow references semcod/planfile/.github/workflows/planfile-sync-reusable.yml by the mutable tag v0.1.126 while holding issues:write on an hourly schedule. A moved tag or compromised upstream repository could execute arbitrary code with issue-writing access.
delivery.change: Pin the reusable workflow reference to the immutable commit SHA e79d79509c050514ba434c3bd6589f932b91c920 (the commit the v0.1.126 tag points at), keeping the version in a trailing comment.
acceptance: The workflow uses-action references e79d79509c050514ba434c3bd6589f932b91c920 and retains a v0.1.126 version comment.
